dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline curvature on the posterior margin, exhibiting a high degree of falcation relative to the base-to-apex axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius resulting in an acute, sharply rounded termination at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Strongly inclined anterior margin with a variable slope that increases in steepness as it approaches the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide-based morphology where the horizontal pixel span at the base exceeds the vertical pixel height by a factor of approximately 1.6.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex parabolic arc with a consistent radius, forming a prominent rounded forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Relatively short and thick pixel projection extending from the melon, exhibiting minimal terminal tapering.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several fine, linear depigmented markings (scratches) are visible on the lateral flank; a distinct white patch or lesion is present on the leading edge of the primary visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic network patterns from surface light refraction are distributed across the dorsal and mid-lateral regions.
